Solvothermal coordination anchoring of eosin Y on Ce-BTC nanorods improves the operational stability of photocatalytic hydrogen evolution.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nr02183b

item.title: Wet chemical synthesis and structural analysis of high-entropy perovskite oxide nanoparticles for energy-related applications
item.description:
Authors: Simon Moore, Mari Takahashi, Ryogo Ishihara, Jun Uzuhashi, Tsunehiro Takeuchi, Tadakatsu Ohkubo, Shinya Maenosono

Sustainable high-entropy perovskite oxide nanoparticles have been synthesised by a hydrothermal method. Mn or N doping reduced the band gap energy. Ta and Nb doping increased electrical conductivity and entropic effects reduced thermal conductivity.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nr03086f

item.title: Fate of hydrogen sulphide on refractory oxide nanoparticles via foundation model-accelerated atomistic modelling and in situ spectroscopy
item.description:
Authors: Eric Mates-Torres, Lorenzo Mino, Guillermo Escolano-Casado, Nadia Balucani, Piero Ugliengo, Albert Rimola

A foundation machine-learned potential screens the adsorption of hydrogen sulphide on silica, forsterite and MgO, and DFT refines every candidate. The DFT-simulated IR spectra reproduce the order of the H–S stretching bands measured in situ .

DOI: 10.1039/d6nr02993k

item.title: Recent advances in biomedical applications of rare-earth-doped halide perovskite nanomaterials
item.description:
Authors: Mingjun Bai, Chunxin Zhang, Mingxiu Peng, Jiajie Tan, Hui Guo, Ying Zhang, Hao Wan, Renzhi Ma

This review summarizes the synthesis, characterization, and optical properties of rare-earth-doped halide perovskites, highlighting their potential for rapid, stable, low-background multimodal theranostics and future clinical translation.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nr02770a
